Label the numbers in beat 18 (for example 'LEG RANGE: 53° vs 122°') and give the stake in plain words on screen ('half reps = wasted set') so the verdict feels earned.

Drop 'JUDGE = an AI judge (Claude Fable 5.2)', the coach quote duplicates and half the courtroom nouns: keep trial, guilty and witness, and lose exhibit, sentence and retrial.

Make the Salesforce turn feel planned and paid off. Enlarge the corner tag at beat 8 and reword it as a viewer stake ('AT THE END: THE AI JOB THAT'S HIRING DURING LAYOFFS'). Say the link aloud in beat 22 instead of only on screen. End with a specific promise ('Part 2: the 3 skills in this posting'), not a bare FOLLOW.

Use one ask per moment. Beat 19 currently has send plus comment FORM, and it reads as the end of the reel, which causes exits at 50 s. Keep the half-rep send line there, move 'comment FORM' to the final card beside FOLLOW, and keep the bed's energy up through beat 20. In TRIAL, re-pin the reverse-crunch clip as Exhibit A after the blast so beat 18's reveal still has a setup, since the hook has already given away the lunge.

Cut on-screen text in beats 9-14 to one line each. Beats 12, 13 and 14 each carry a headline, a small tag and a chip or typed quote in 2-3 s; drop the model name, the '4 of 23' tag and the arXiv credit to captions or the comment, and let the footage and one line carry each beat.

'Wrongful conviction', 'Retrial', 'The sentence', 'Last case' and 'a witness' force a translation step at each beat; keep 'on trial / guilty' for the hook and verdict and say the rest plainly ('It got my lunges wrong', 'Now both must agree, so the lunge gets a second look').

Give the trainer and mass group a reason to stay and send earlier: move a short version of the half-rep line onto screen at beat 7 or 10 as text only ('you know someone who counts half reps'), keeping the spoken send line at beat 19, and make beat 22-23 state one concrete thing the next reel delivers instead of 'how do you get ready'.
